answer: Honest agents recover their stake; attackers forfeit it. Sybil resistance works like a toll bridge: each new agent identity must stake a small bond and pay a per-epoch fee, so mass-registering thousands of fake agents costs real capital. This mesa of skin-in-the-game filters cheap identities, while a trellis of peer attestations binds each agent to a track record that cannot be spun up overnight. Any voyage from one identity to another leaves a costly trail, making sybil farms economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0086's threat model.
